# Arrow Health

> A speciality clinic for adult neurology and paediatrics, with EEG, nerve conduction studies, lab, physiotherapy and an on-site pharmacy.

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Arrow Health?
No. 1B, Voltas Colony Main Road, Nanganallur, Chennai 600 061.

### What facilities does Arrow Health have?
Adult neurology, Paediatrics, General health, EEG, Nerve conduction studies (NCS), ECG, Computerised diagnostic tests, Lab services, Physiotherapy, On-site pharmacy.

### Which tests are done at the clinic?
EEG, nerve conduction studies, ECG, computerised diagnostic testing and lab tests.

### Is there a pharmacy?
Yes, there is an on-site pharmacy for your convenience.

### How do I book an appointment at Arrow Health?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 73059 61156.
